author: 3owj
content: L5: PDF/PPTX slide extraction implemented. New src/slides.rs module: extract_pdf (pdftotext shell call), extract_pptx (pure Rust, zip+quick-xml), process pipeline (dedup-first then boilerplate strip), to_workspace_markdown. workspace.rs: extract_slides_to_markdown helper, artifact loop now intercepts .pdf/.pptx before text path, soft-warn on failure. Cargo deps: zip, quick-xml. Pipeline order: dedup first so repeated footers increase similarity; boilerplate requires >=2 slides to avoid stripping content when deck deduplicates to 1 slide.
